title: Pricing rows show for a customer with no address
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the client has more than one active tier.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales, with no address and an IBS value.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card's Pricing section shows Labor Rate, Shop Supplies, Tax and both tier rows.
  • The card's other rows, IBS included, stay hidden as today.
